label: AB4C_oI120_46_b2c_2b9c_b2c-001
title: Ordered Calcined AlPO$_{4}$-11 Structure
comments:
Samples of large-pore AlPO$_{4}$-11 were calcined at 873K to remove impurities and then dehydrated at 573K. Data was collected at 295K. 
 (Richardson, 1988) found the ordered structure shown here, but also found a good fit to the data by assuming a \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2_oI120_74_h2j_aef2i3j-001}{disordered phase} where the aluminum and phosphorous atoms are randomly distributed. 
 Unlike the 12-member nearly circular ring in \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oI120_46_b2c_2b9c_b2c-001}{AlPO$_{4}$-5}, here the ring onl has aluminum and phosphorous atoms and is elliptical. 
 More information about AlPO$_{4}$ structures can be found on the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{SiO$_{2}$ and AlPO$_{4}$} page. 
 (Richardson, 1988) give the data for this structure in the $Icm2$ setting of space group \#46.  Fortunately the ICSD entry is given in the standard $Ima2$ setting.
